name: Army (Zhodani)
description: Members of the Consulate's ground-based armed fighting forces or the ground forces of individual worlds. Zhodani soldiers fight in planetary surface actions, battles, and campaigns.

cavalry.name: Cavalry
cavalry.description: You serve in a tank or other ground vehicle.

infantry.name: Infantry
infantry.description: You serve as a fighting man on the ground or with shipboard troops.

support.name: Support
support.description: You serve in one of the many Army support roles.

mishaps.1: Severely injured in action. Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: You are involved in a disastrous campaign and barely escape off planet. Gain D3 Contacts as you return home. Roll on the Re-education Events table.
mishaps.3: You are sent to battle against insurgents and discharged because of stress or injury. Gain one level of Recon or Survival. If SOC 10+, gain an Enemy as the government buries the incident. If SOC 9-, roll on the Re-education Events table.
mishaps.4: You discover that your commanding officer is engaged in illegal activity. If you join him, gain an Ally before the inevitable investigation; roll on the Re-education Events table. Alternatively, cooperate with the Thought Police — you must leave the career but keep your Benefit roll.
mishaps.5: You have problems working with an officer or fellow soldier. If SOC 10+, gain that officer as a Rival as he drives you out of the Army. If SOC 9-, roll on the Re-education Events table.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table but you are not ejected from this career, even from a Re-education Event.
events.3: You are assigned to an urbanised world torn by war. Gain one level of Stealth, Persuade or Recon.
events.4: You are assigned to a world with a hostile or wild environment. Gain one level of Vacc Suit, Engineer, Animals or Recon.
events.5: You are sent to Commando training. Gain one level of Vacc Suit, Heavy Weapons or Athletics (Dexterity). If you have SOC 10+, you may leave this career (mustering out as normal) and then automatically qualify for the Guard career (with the same rank) next term.
events.6: You are thrown into a brutal ground war. Roll Gun Combat or Stealth 8+ to avoid injury; if successful, gain one level of Gun Combat, Leadership or Tactics (Military).
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Zhodani Life Events table.
events.8: You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 8+ to gain one level in any skill already possessed.
events.9: Surrounded and outnumbered, you hold out until relief arrives. Gain DM+2 to the next Advancement roll.
events.10: You are assigned to a peacekeeping role. Gain one level of Admin, Investigate or Recon.
events.11: Your commanding officer takes an interest in your career. Gain him as an Ally and gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: You display heroism in battle. Your next Advancement roll is automatically successful.
